external_anchor.oss_repo: sailfish-team/sailfish (LGPL3), cached at /tmp/sf/sailfish on the fleet nodes

files.sym_equilibrium.py:26-48: free_energy_equilibrium_fluid: pb = rho/3 + A(-phi^2/2 + 3 phi^4/4); kappa anisotropy through wxx/wyy/wzz/wxy/wyz/wxz; f_0 = rho - sum_{i>0}
files.sym_equilibrium.py:50-70: free_energy_equilibrium_order_param: mu = A(-phi+phi^3) - kappa lap(phi); g_i = w_i(Gamma mu + e.u phi + 3/2 phi((e.u)^2 - u^2/3)); g_0 = phi - sum
files.lb_binary.py:185-268: D2Q9 wi/wxx/wyy/wxy tables (axis 1/3, diag 1/12; wxx=1/3 axis-x, -1/6 other axis, -1/24 diag; wxy = ex ey /4)
files.templates/finite_difference_optimized.ma: nine-point isotropic grad/lap used for grad(phi) and lap(phi) on D2Q9

external_anchor.method_lineage: Pooley, Furtado & Carr, Phys. Rev. E 78, 056709 (2008) -- free-energy binary-fluid LB with the pressure tensor embedded in the equilibrium; continuum anchors xi = sqrt(2 kappa/A), sigma = (2/3) sqrt(2 kappa A) (derived in module docstring and re-derived in docs)
external_anchor.transplant_note: sailfish is CUDA/JIT (sympy codegen + pyopencl/pycuda); it is NOT executable in this environment. The comparison arm is therefore a semantics-exact transplant of its equilibrium, coefficients and FD operators into tensorlbm/phasefield/free_energy_pressure.py, cited line by line. This is recorded as a comparison limit, not upgraded to an OSS binary run.

decision: Does the transplanted pressure-tensor free-energy binary model reproduce the analytic equilibrium pressure physics (surface tension from the measured pressure tensor, Laplace law on curved interfaces) within the owner band of 15%?

metrics.closure_rel: max_ab max_x | sum_i f_i^eq c_ia c_ib - (P_ab + rho u_a u_b) | / max|P|, P from pressure_tensor_analytic with the SAME nine-point operators (gate, not physics)
metrics.sigma_band: surface tension measured on the periodic flat band: sum over x of (P_xx - P_yy) from the second moment of the populations / 2 (two interfaces)
metrics.Pnn_uniformity_rel: max_x |P_NN(x) - mean_x P_NN| / mean_x P_NN across the band (mechanical equilibrium, d P_NN/dx = 0)
metrics.dp_droplet: p_in - p_out from p = (P_xx + P_yy)/2 of the measured populations, p_in averaged over r <= R - 3 xi, p_out over R + 3 xi <= r <= L/2 - 1
metrics.sigma_ray: integral of (P_rr - P_tt) dr averaged over 16 rays through the droplet centre (independent sigma measurement on a curved interface)
metrics.spurious_velocity: max |u| over the field (static interface; parasitic current, reported not accepted as a physics KPI)
metrics.mass_drift: |sum rho - N| / N and |sum phi - sum phi_0| / |sum phi_0| (conservation)

unit_of_analysis: one completed arm (flat band, or one droplet radius) at fixed (A, xi, Gamma, tau_f, tau_phi, grid, step budget); KPIs are scalars, plus per-arm profile arrays

baseline_control.physics_baseline: analytic free-energy anchors: sigma = (2/3) sqrt(2 kappa A) = (2/3) A xi, mechanical equilibrium d(P_NN)/dx = 0 on a flat interface, Laplace law dp = sigma/R
baseline_control.independent_measurement: sigma_ray (curved interface) vs sigma_band (flat interface) vs sigma_analytic -- three independent routes to the same number
baseline_control.oss_control: the sailfish semantic transplant described in external_anchor (cited, not executed)

predeclared_thresholds.interpretation: the arm passes iff every physics KPI is inside 15% AND the closure gate is at machine precision AND the conservation/stability rules hold; the closure threshold is 3 orders stricter because it is an algebra identity, not a physics comparison

stability_rule: any non-finite population, rho outside [0.9, 1.1], or max|u| > 0.1 declares the arm failed and is reported, never tuned away
stopping_rule: each droplet arm stops early when the Laplace jump drift |dp(n) - dp(n-500)|/|dp(n)| < 1e-3, otherwise at the predeclared step budget; no arm is extended after looking at KPIs
parameter_screening_note: the declared parameter point (A=0.1, Gamma=0.2, tau_phi=1.5 => M = 0.0667, tau_f=1.0 => nu = 1/6) was selected by a stability screening on a 64^2 R=10 droplet (Gamma=1.0 with tau_phi=1.5 went non-finite at step ~200; Gamma<=0.5 was finite over 1200 steps). The screening is reported as parameter sensitivity (5) and was not used to select thresholds.
variables_changed: interface topology: flat band vs circular droplet
confounders: the periodic flat band has TWO interfaces, so sigma_band must be halved before comparison
the droplet pressure is measured from the second moment of f, which includes non-equilibrium contributions O(Ma^2) that are not negligible at the 1e-3 level
the LBM pressure is the free-energy pressure; the density jump across the interface carries part of dp, so p_in - p_out must be measured far from the interface
Ray integration uses nearest-neighbour sampling on a 0.5 dx radial grid: adequate at xi >= 2 but it is a source of a few percent error

environment.compute: cluster job (2x loong64 nodes) for the production arms; local only for smoke runs

analysis: per-arm scalars; the three sigma routes and the three Laplace ratios are compared as a table; no outlier removal; sensitivity reported as the spread across R and xi
fail_stage_plan: fail_stage names the stage (transplant / closure / flat_band / droplet / laplace / analysis) and failure_reason carries the measured deviation
